# Fundesk

> > Learning portal for data structures & algorithms, Python/Java programming, machine learning, and AI automation—built by FAANG engineers.

Fundesk offers technical tutorials on DSA problems, custom ML implementations, and modern AI workflows. The site also provides AI engineering consulting services focused on workflow automation, custom agents, and LLM integration.

## Key Topics

- Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA)
- Binary Search Tree (BST)
- Linked List algorithms
- Java implementations
- Python programming
- Machine Learning (Logistic Regression, NumPy)
- AI Agents and Agentic Workflows
- Vision Agents (Claude 3.5, GPT-4o)
- AI Coding Tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf)
- ChatGPT and Claude integration
- Iterative and from-scratch implementations
- Array and matrix algorithms
- UI testing automation
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- Technical interview preparation

## Core Pages

- [Portal for Java and Python Programming, DSA and Algorithm Resources and Technical Interview Preparation.](https://www.fundesk.io): Learning portal for DSA, Python, Java, AI/ML, and interview preparation

- [About Us | Fundesk](https://www.fundesk.io/about-us): FAANG engineers offering AI automation and software engineering services

- [AI Coding Agents Compared: Cursor vs Copilot vs Claude Code vs Windsurf in 2026 - Fundesk](https://www.fundesk.io/ai-coding-agents-compared-cursor-copilot-claude-code-windsurf-2026): Compare Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Windsurf with benchmarks & pricing
- [Automating UI Testing with Vision Agents: Catching Visual Bugs Before They Ship - Fundesk](https://www.fundesk.io/automating-ui-testing-vision-agents): Vision agents for UI testing with Claude 3.5, GPT-4o, and visual bug detection

## Data Structures: Linked Lists

- [Program to reverse a linked list using iterative approach - Fundesk](https://www.fundesk.io/program-to-reverse-a-linked-list-using-iterative-approach): Reverse linked list iteratively with Java implementation and algorithm

- [Sort a Linked List with 0s 1s and 2s - Fundesk](https://www.fundesk.io/sort-linked-list-with-zero-one-two): Sort linked list with 0s, 1s, 2s using O(N) counting sort in Java

## Array & Matrix Algorithms

- [3 Sum: Find All Unique Triplets that Sum to Zero - Fundesk](https://www.fundesk.io/3-sum): Solve 3Sum problem with two-pointer approach achieving O(N^2) complexity
- [Spiral Matrix - Fundesk](https://www.fundesk.io/spiral-matrix): Traverse matrix in spiral order using boundary-based approach in Java
- [Rotate 2D Matrix by 90 Degrees - Fundesk](https://www.fundesk.io/rotate-matrix-90-degrees): Rotate matrix 90° in-place using transpose and reversal in Python
- [Pair with given sum in rotated array - Fundesk](https://www.fundesk.io/pair-with-given-sum-in-rotated-array): Find pair sum in rotated sorted array using two-pointer technique in Java
